profile.name: SANKALP YERAWAR
profile.subtitle: Backend Development & Distributed Systems Architect
summary: 7+ years of experience as a backend-focused software engineer specializing in scalable distributed systems and microservices architecture.

Expertise in Kotlin, Java, and cloud-native patterns (AWS Lambda, Serverless). Proven track record in designing real-time data pipelines (Kafka) and high-performance storage solutions (Cassandra, PostgreSQL).
Passionate about clean code, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and TDD. actively exploring AI-assisted development to deliver faster, cleaner solutions.
